name: Nest Treasury Vault
oneLiner: nTBILL is Nest's NAV-accreting Treasury vault token, routing into Janus Henderson JTRSY and Superstate USTB short-duration T-bill exposure.
collateral: Tokenised short-duration U.S. Treasury exposure routed by Nest into Janus Henderson JTRSY and Superstate USTB positions, plus a small stablecoin liquidity buffer
pegMechanism: Vault LP token whose value targets a dollar base and accretes through underlying Treasury fund NAV; primary mint and redemption occur through Nest at vault NAV against USDC and pUSD

mechanismArchetypeReview.reviewer: SONG Safety Score V9 mechanism review
mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Nest materials identify nTBILL as a Treasury-bill fund-share exposure, but the reviewed sources do not provide the current compiler-required assurance, reconciliation, custody continuity, seniority, liquidity, valuation, or loss-recovery inputs for a complete mechanism review.

notices.title: NAV-style dollar asset
notices.message: nTBILL is a Nest vault share whose value tracks the underlying Treasury fund book. It behaves like a vault share rather than a hard 1:1 par stablecoin.
